place.title: Place {ref} (flame sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 3 pins into column f, one pin per row: VCC into {hole.vcc}, GND into {hole.gnd}, DO into {hole.do}. The dark round sensor points up, away from the breadboard.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins. If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture.

why: {ref} watches for the infrared light a flame gives off; when it sees enough of it, it pulls its DO pin LOW and its second LED lights.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND pin to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref} from 3.3 V, so its output signal is never more than the Pico's 3.3 V.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}'s DO output: 0 while it sees a flame, 1 otherwise. The module drives this line itself.
